content.text:
mkdir -p /app /models /data &&\
    mkdir -p ${HF_HOME} &&\
    mkdir -p ${PIP_CACHE_DIR} &&\
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive &&\
    echo "Update repo" &&\
    apt-get -yy update &&\
    echo "Install packages" &&\
    apt-get -yy install --no-install-recommends \
        tzdata \
        ffmpeg \
        portaudio19-dev \
        gcc \
        curl \
        gpg \
        gosu \
        libpq-dev \
        python${PYTHON_VERSION} \
        python${PYTHON_VERSION}-dev \
        python3-pip \
        python-is-python3 \
    && \
    ln -sf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && \
    echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

RUN echo "Install" &&\
    mv pyproject.$CUDA.toml pyproject.toml &&\
    pip install uv &&\
    uv lock --preview -v &&\
    uv sync -v &&\
    mv .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/asr_service/ui .


RUN  echo "Cleanup" && \
    rm -rf /dist && \
    apt-get autoremove -yy &&\
    apt-get autoclean -yy &&\
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

VOLUME ["/models", "/data"]

EXPOSE 8090

ENTRYPOINT ["/docker-entrypoint.sh"]

CMD ["start"]
